B - Same Map in the RPG World Editorial

Time Limit: 2 sec / Memory Limit: 1024 MiB

問題文

日本語の問題文

Score : 200200200 points

Problem Statement

Takahashi has a grid with HH𝐻HH rows and cell Ai,jA_{i,j}Ai,j is # or ..

Determine whether B can be obtained.

Constraints

  • 2 \leq H, W \leq 302≤H,W≤30
  • All values in the input are integers.

Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

HH WW
A_{1,1}A_{1,2}\dots A_{1,W}A1,1

Output

Print Yes or No.

Copy
4 3
..#
#..

Sample Output 1Copy

Copy
Yes
